    Physics
    
      
    
    
    
    Changes apply instantly. Heavier cars hit harder and soak up damage. Front weight moves the centre of mass. Air stability keeps the nose on the flight path so jumps land wheels-down.

    Demolition derby · physics sandbox
    
      
    Scrapyard Derby
    
      
    Wreck every opponent in the yard. Hit them nose first: your front bumper takes half damage. Knock off bumpers, doors and wheels. Every car has real mass, suspension and momentum.
    
      
    
        
    Multiplayer 
    
        
    
        
    
        
    No internet service: the phones scan each other's screens, then talk over your Wi-Fi.
    
        
    
        
    
        
    
        
    
        
    Family yard name
    Everyone whose game has the same name here lands in the same yard when they tap Play together. Pick something only your family knows — and for a yard nobody can guess, set the same 4-digit PIN on every device. Up to 11 guests can drive; AI fill the rest of the field.
    
        
    Scan to join, or send this link:
     
    
      
    
      
    
        
    Pick your car
    
        
    
        
    
      
    
      
    
      
    Green wrenches repair you and refit a lost wheel; blue canisters refill nitro. Bright, glowing junk flies when you hit it. Dark objects are heavy and shove back. Hazard stripes mean solid: steer around.
    
      
    
        Controls
        
    
          
    W / ↑
    Throttle
    
          
    S / ↓
    Brake, then reverse once stopped
    
          
    A D / ← →
    Steer (on the ground only)
    
          
    Shift
    Nitro
    
          
    Space / X
    Handbrake: rear wheels lock and slide
    
          
    H
    Horn
    
          
    J
    Hydraulic jump
    
          
    F / click
    Fire a 3-round burst (Tiger)
    
          
    G
    Siren (Cruiser)
    
          
    F / click
    Your car's special weapon: harpoon, oil, spikes, flamethrower, propane bomb, water cannon, rocket ram, cannon, concrete or fuel
    
          
    V
    Wheelie (Hellbender)
    
          
    Q / E
    In the air: pitch nose down / up
    
          
    R · N
    Reset car · restart match
    
          
    C · T · P
    Camera · tune physics · pause
    
          
    M · B
    Sound · music
    
          
    Touch
    Drag left side to steer, pedals on the right
